review_policy: Three independent scopes: official transaction/merchant string; external establishment existence; exact payment branch proven only from row-linked official address, receipt, or verifiable merchant identifiers. Search results and business addresses NEVER prove which branch accepted the payment.

status_definitions.VENUE_FOUND_PAYMENT_UNVERIFIED: Existing restaurant address corroborated, but payment-branch identity not established
status_definitions.MULTIPLE_BRANCHES: Several plausible establishments for same merchant string
status_definitions.CONFLICTING_LOCATION_EVIDENCE: Plausible establishment has conflicting published addresses
status_definitions.NON_DINING_BUSINESS: Business type externally evidenced as not a restaurant
status_definitions.POSSIBLE_ALIAS_NOT_PROVEN: Similar trade names may describe the same store or brand, but are not merged absent row-linked evidence
status_definitions.AMBIGUOUS_NAME_NO_BRANCH: Merchant name is broad or shared; physical establishment is unverified
